correctness.rationale: For all specified positive parameters, monotone per-capita nullclines give exactly one coexistence equilibrium above \(b_0=m/(cU)\). Its Jacobian determinant is -eta F_u-cb F_v>0, giving \(u_b<0\). Elimination yields \(f_v<0\), \(f_{uu}<0\), positive \(v=h(u)\) with zero endpoint limits; at every critical point h_uu=-f_uu/\(f_v<0\). Hence there is exactly one global maximum and it is nondegenerate in b. Exact witness (r,k,alpha,a,c,m,eta)=(25,1,3,1,1,1,3), (u,v,b)=(1,1,4) gives determinant 32 and \(v_{bb}=-11/320\). Standalone SymPy checker passed. No finite computation is used as proof of the universal quantifier.

value.rationale: The source paper presents only local-range monotone refuge and predation sensitivity. A sharp one-peak theorem for all positive parameters, analytic optimal-refuge criterion and exact feasible witness resolve the full ecological response, including reversal under sufficiently high attack intensity. This is a nontrivial structural classification rather than a parameter substitution or a generic repetition of the known overexploitation phenomenon; it needs the strict global implicit-curve curvature argument.
